example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সাদা চামড়া বলে সবাই তাকে বিদেশী মনে করে।
উনি সাদা চামড়ার লোক, তাই ইংরেজি ভালো বলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He is considered a foreigner because of his white skin.
She is a white-skinned person, so she speaks English fluently.
history: This idiom originates from the British colonial period in Bengal, where 'white skin' was used to refer to European colonizers and residents.
note: The phrase carries connotations of colonial history and racial distinction in Bengali society.
